findings.title: With Merge pets on, a pet ahead of its owner in a column loses its numbers to the owner's own cell
findings.evidence: foldPet creates the owner's cell from the pet's figures when absent; when the owner's own source arrives later, setCell replaces the cell outright (row.values[statKey] = {...}). Order-dependent: pet-after-owner sums, pet-before-owner is overwritten. Probe: sources PET 400 -> BETA 200 -> ALPHA 100 with mergePets gave 'expected 500, got 100' for ALPHA DamageDone.total. Affects total, rate, percent and /mm export, out of combat on Current/Overall/pinned views, for anyone with Merge pets ticked (default off) whose pet out-ranks them in any column.
findings.remediation: Make the own-source write add to a cell a pet fold created, under the same Secrets.CanCompare2 and type guards foldPet uses; add a red-first case (testing-§12). Watch placeSource CCN <= 15.
